discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis)
rationale: The 2023-2025 Chemistry prizes went to quantum dots, protein design and structure prediction, and metal-organic frameworks. Sequencing by synthesis is a widely recognized chemistry-driven invention whose inventors have not yet won. It changed genomics and medicine, and its inventors already hold major prizes, including the Breakthrough Prize. Chemistry committees often give such work to the chemists who developed the method.
